name: Saint's Street
desc1: Saint's Street is where the remains of all the former priests of the
desc2: local temple are buried. It is a small, but elaborate graveyard with
desc3: elaborately chiseled crosses and tombstones. Each stone details in
desc4: great length the life of the particular priest. Strangely, the soil
desc5: is normal here, and the plants flourish. The ground is free of all
desc6: snow and sign of decay that you see elsewhere.
